title: Drone telemetry and rural 5G radio measurements
question: How do altitude and radio conditions affect link reliability across flights?
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Pérez-Aguilar, Adrián; Diaz Zayas, Almudena
measurement_dates: Flight filenames and telemetry identify 2025-03-31; source release 2025-08-01.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
validation_design: Complete flight and spatial/temporal blocks. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Nemo/telemetry exports with sparse fields, duplicate labels and distinct clocks. The RTT plot is source context; a numeric synchronized per-packet latency series is not promised.
prior_analysis_and_limits: RuralDrone5G uses the Victoria Network / La Mayora experimental farm, Malaga, Spain. Affiliation fields are absent in the Zenodo creator metadata; named authors and platform context are retained without inventing institutions. Altitude and position may be confounded by flight path. Five rural-drone flights with radio and telemetry streams; synchronize using source clocks without fabricating missing alignments.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
